title: Session
description: A plugin session — one problem being worked through the clarify step (review) → :team → :verify → :boss → :revise. Stored as .argus/sessions/{id}/session.json. TEAM-SAFE SKELETON: this file holds only small, slow-changing coordination state (identity, phase, routing, draft-tree pointers). The heavy per-run artifacts (analysis, workers, mix, verification, boss feedback, scaffold) live authoritatively and WRITE-ONCE in versions/{label}/*.json — they are NOT duplicated here, so two teammates committing sessions to git do not collide on a monolithic blob. Session ids carry a short author suffix (see clarify) so the same problem from two people becomes two non-colliding directories that still both travel via git.

id.description: Session ID (slug-safe, human-readable preferred over UUID for directory naming).

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the repo this session belongs to. Plugin uses this for code-native context.

repo_branch.description: Git branch at session start. Helps recover context.

invoking_context.description: What the user was working on when they invoked argus.

target_ref.description: PR#, file path, branch name, etc.

boss_agent.description: Configured Boss for this session, echoed from .argus/config.yaml at session start. Seat-first since O3 방3 — role/owns/goals/authority carry the substance; tone is voice only.

mbti_code.description: LEGACY alias of tone (pre-O3 sessions) — voice only, never the source of concerns (R42).

phase.description: Plugin phase. Verification is first-class: team output becomes a candidate until the verify step (review) marks what is supported, challenged, or blocked.

classification.description: Output of the team step (review) classification step. May be partially populated by /argus:review Step 6b (user-confirmed stakes) before team runs.

stakes_confidence.description: Confidence in stakes assignment. <75 triggers sail Step 6b AskUserQuestion. 100 means user-confirmed.

stakes_user_confirmed.description: True when sail Step 6b ran and the user explicitly chose the stakes level. When true, the team step (review) Step 2 must NOT re-classify stakes — only fill steps_classified.

drafts.description: Version tree of completed drafts (POINTERS, not heavy data). drafts[0] = root. Each draft references its versions/{label}/ dir where the authoritative scaffold/workers/mix/verification/boss artifacts live write-once. The full per-run artifacts are NOT stored here — read them from the version dir. This keeps the draft tree small and append-mostly so concurrent team commits don't conflict.

revise_cycles.description: How many --revise rework cycles have run for this session. Incremented by the team step (review) at the start of each --revise run (the single chokepoint both the the revise step (review) path and sail's revise_team routing cross). Bounds the automated revise loop together with max_revise_cycles.

max_revise_cycles.description: Hard cap on revise cycles (default 3). Set via the revise step (review) --max-revisions <N>. When revise_cycles reaches it, verify routes stop_for_human_check and team writes remaining challenges to human_required_checkpoints (reason: max_revisions_reached) instead of looping.
